long_description:
Find your balance beneath the glow of the full moon in The Piazza at Tivoli Village Las Vegas!

About this Event

Reconnect with your mind and body during an evening of movement, mindfulness, and community at The Piazza at Tivoli Village. Join FIT4MOM Las Vegas for a complimentary outdoor Full Moon Yoga class from 6:30 – 7:30 PM, led by Marina and designed for all experience levels.
Whether you're a seasoned yogi or simply looking for a peaceful way to unwind, this relaxing class offers the perfect opportunity to recharge in one of Las Vegas' most beautiful outdoor settings.
Monday, October 26, 2026 | 6:30 - 7:30 PM
What to Bring:
Yoga matWater bottlePositive energyTake a moment for yourself, invite a friend, and enjoy an evening of relaxation under the full moon. Registration is complimentary, but space is limited.
